notes:
The page number moves into the tool sidebar, and the page gets slightly larger.

**The page position now lives at the bottom of the tool sidebar** instead of in its own strip across the bottom of the screen. It was previously showing the same number the page slider already displays.

**Your music is slightly larger as a result.** Removing that strip gives its height back to the page — noticeable on pieces you have cropped, where the page size is limited by height rather than width.

In a playlist, the position in the setlist appears on a second line beneath the page number. The piece title is no longer repeated there, since it is already on the tab.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
